## Changes and purpose
Describe the affected entity IDs, role/domain classifications and mapping claims.

## Evidence and limits
Identify actual source passages inspected and which claims they establish. Distinguish inherited citations, new inspection, constructed examples, predictions and observed data. No migration or green check grants scientific review.

## Validation
Record commands actually executed and results. Confirm canonical records and generated views agree. For a dependency change, include the exact editorial review record; never silently refresh the snapshot.

## Compatibility and privacy
Describe identity aliases, preserved links and migration effects. Confirm no private learner records, restricted material or credentials were added.
